svg.title: IV. Lanterns along the path
svg.desc: The path: software architect at B-Hive since August 2026; mentor at the Mission Locale in Altkirch (January to June 2026); web development trainer at Elan Formation (December 2025 to May 2026), every learner certified; independent developer at Dev-Mates since November 2025; lead and maintainer of the French team of PvZ Fusion since October 2025; full-stack developer intern at ATIS Solutions (August to September 2025).

text.tspan: Each role is a lantern lit along the way.
